seo.metaDescription: Thực sử dụng các mẫu câu đơn giản để hỏi và trả lời.

HD.HD-04: Hello John, do you like to play sports?
Yes, I enjoy playing football and tennis.
What games do you like on your phone?
I often play video games in my free time.
Do you like to listen to music or sing?
Yes, I like to listen to songs and dance.
What is your favorite TV show or movie?
I like cartoons and action films a lot.
Do you enjoy reading books or stories?
Yes, I read stories and books about art.
Is drawing and painting your hobby too?
Yes, I enjoy painting pictures on weekends.
What do you like to do at a party or picnic?
I like to dance and play games at parties.
Do you like going to the park or the beach?
I enjoy swimming and cycling at the beach.
Have you ever been on a travel trip or camp?
Yes, I like camping and going on trips.
What sport do you play most, football or badminton?
I play football every weekend with friends.
Do you watch basketball games on TV?
Yes, basketball is fun to watch and play.
What kind of music do you like to listen to?
I like pop songs and sometimes sing along.
Do you have a hobby that you enjoy at home?
Yes, I enjoy playing video games and reading.
How often do you use the internet or phone?
I use my phone every day to call and text.
Do you chat with friends in groups online?
Yes, I like chatting with my friends online.
Do you take photos or videos with your camera?
Yes, I often take photos at parties and trips.
What do you do to relax or rest on weekends?
I relax by watching movies and playing games.
Do you enjoy weekend holidays or trips?
Yes, I like to travel on holidays with friends.
Do you listen to music when you exercise?
Yes, music helps me enjoy cycling and running.
What games do you like to play with your friends?
We like to play football and video games.
Do you like singing at parties or at home?
I like singing at parties with my group.
What is your favorite song to sing?
My favorite song is one about friendship.
Do you watch cartoons or films more?
I like watching cartoons on Saturday nights.
Do you enjoy painting or drawing more?
I enjoy drawing pictures more than painting.
Thank you, John, for sharing your hobbies.
You are welcome, Lisa. I enjoyed this talk.

TV.TV-04: Chào buổi sáng, John. Cảm ơn bạn đã tham gia cùng tôi.
TV.TV-05: buổi sáng

TV.TV-04: Vâng, tôi thích chơi bóng đá và quần vợt.
TV.TV-05: tận hưởng, chơi, bóng đá, quần vợt

TV.TV-04: Bạn thích chơi trò chơi nào trên điện thoại?
TV.TV-05: trò chơi, như, điện thoại

TV.TV-04: Tôi thường chơi trò chơi điện tử vào thời gian rảnh rỗi.
TV.TV-05: chơi, trò chơi điện tử, thời gian rảnh rỗi

TV.TV-04: Bạn thích nghe nhạc hay hát?
TV.TV-05: nghe, nhạc, hát

HD.HD-04: John, how do you keep your body healthy daily?
I always wash my face and hands every morning.
Do you exercise to keep your body strong?
Yes, I like to walk and run in the park daily.
What do you do when your head hurts or aches?
I rest and take medicine for my headache pain.
Do you ever get a sore throat or cough?
Sometimes I have a cough with a cold in winter.
How do you feel if your stomach or heart hurts?
I feel weak and need to see a doctor quickly.
Have you ever been sick or ill at the hospital?
Yes, I stayed one night at the hospital once.
Did a nurse or doctor give you medicine there?
Yes, the nurse gave me pills and an injection.
What kind of medicine do you usually take?
I take tablets for pain and cough when needed.
How often do you sleep to keep your body strong?
I usually sleep eight hours every single night.
Do you wash your hair and clean your skin daily?
Yes, I wash my hair and skin every morning.
What should you do if your ear or nose hurts?
You should rest and see the doctor if it hurts.
How do you care for your mouth and teeth?
I brush my teeth twice and wash my mouth well.
Does your neck or shoulder ever feel pain?
Sometimes after work my neck and shoulders hurt.
How do you make your back and leg feel better?
I rest and do light exercise to feel better.
Do your hands or fingers ever have pain or hurt?
Yes, sometimes my fingers hurt after typing.
What about your foot and toe? Any problems?
No, my foot and toes are strong and healthy.
How do you keep your heart healthy and strong?
I eat healthy food and exercise every morning.
Do you feel weak when you are sick or ill?
Yes, sickness makes me feel very weak.
What should you do to avoid getting sick?
You should rest, eat well, and wash your hands.
How often do you check your health with a doctor?
I visit the clinic once a year for a checkup.
Do you ever take injections or shots?
Yes, the doctor gave me an injection before.
How do you feel after taking medicine or pills?
I feel better and my pain slowly goes away.
Do you drink water and eat healthy food daily?
Yes, water and good food help my health.
How do you keep your skin clean and healthy?
I wash my face and use lotion every evening.
What advice do you have for people feeling sick?
Rest well, take medicine, and see the doctor.
